BrowserData_Config_BookmarkTriggerKeywor: Type this keyword (followed by a space and a search term) to search bookmarks, e.g. the default "bb".
BrowserData_Config_HistoryTriggerKeyword: Type this keyword (followed by a space and a search term) to search history, e.g. the default "bh".
BrowserData_Config_IndexHistoryDesc: History can grow much larger than bookmarks -- turn this off to search bookmarks only.
BrowserData_Config_ProfilesDesc: Manually add browser profile folders to index. Supports Chrome-family (Chrome/Edge/Brave/...) and Firefox-family browsers. You can add multiple entries.
BrowserData_Config_IconDataDesc: Leave empty to use the default icon (distinguishes bookmarks from history).
BrowserData_Config_PathDesc: The browser's profile folder, e.g. "...\User Data\Default" for Chrome/Edge, or "...\Profiles\xxxxxxxx.default-release" for Firefox.
BrowserData_PluginDesc: Browser data access plugin. Quickly search and access history, bookmarks, and other data from mainstream browsers.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_BrowserDataInstantProvi: Fuzzy-matches history and bookmarks from mainstream browsers (Chrome, Edge, Firefox) in the search box in real-time.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_BrowserDataTranslationP: Provides UI translation and localization mapping for the Browser Data plugin.
